content:
**Singapore – The five most‑recent individuals to hold the office of Deputy Prime Minister (in chronological order of when they first became DPM)**  

| # | Deputy Prime Minister | Years as Deputy PM* | Undergraduate university (principal degree) |
|---|-----------------------|--------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Lee Hsien Loong** | 1990 – 2004 | **University of Cambridge** – Trinity College (B.A. in Mathematics, 1974) |
| 2 | **Wong Kan Seng** | 1995 – 2005 | **University of Singapore** (now the National University of Singapore) – B.A. (Honours) in Economics, 1969 |
| 3 | **Teo Chee Hean** | 2009 – 2019 (served continuously from 2009) | **University of Cambridge** – Trinity College (B.A. in Engineering, 1975) |
| 4 | **Heng Swee Keat** | 2019 – 2021 | **University of Singapore** (now NUS) – B.Sc. (Honours) in Mathematics, 1979 |
| 5 | **Lawrence Wong** | 2022 – present | **National University of Singapore** – B.Sc. (Honours) in Economics & Computer Science, 1997 |

\*The years shown are the periods during which each person first held the Deputy‑Prime‑Minister portfolio. Some of them served additional terms or continued in the role after the start date listed.

### Quick notes on the universities

* **University of Singapore** merged with Nanyang University in 1980 to become the **National University of Singapore (NUS)**. Alumni who graduated before 1980 are still recorded as having attended the “University of Singapore.”
* Both **Lee Hsien Loong** and **Lawrence Wong** later pursued postgraduate studies at the **Harvard Kennedy School (USA)**, but their undergraduate alma maters are the ones listed above, as requested.  

If you need more detail (e.g., postgraduate qualifications, exact dates of appointment, or other senior ministers who briefly held the DPM post), just let me know!
